facts.text: The resort is oceanfront on Ka'anapali Beach.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Maui Resort & Spa is an oceanfront resort located on the legendary Ka‘anapali Beach.

facts.text: The resort has views of the Pacific, the islands of Lanai and Molokai, and Black Rock.
facts.excerpt: views of the shimmering Paciﬁc and the enchanting islands of Lanai and Molokai as well as iconic Black Rock

facts.text: The Kawaiola Aquatic Playground has six pools overlooking Ka'anapali Beach across 87,000 square feet.
facts.excerpt: Six stunning pools overlooking Ka‘anapali beach and spanning 87,000 square feet of pool playground.

facts.text: The adults-only pool deck has a whirlpool and an infinity-edge pool with views of the Pacific and the islands of Molokai and Lanai.
facts.excerpt: The newly redesigned adults-only pool deck area features a whirlpool and an infinity edge pool with uninterrupted views of the Pacific and the neighboring islands of Molokai and Lanai.

facts.text: The family pool area has an interactive Keiki Splash Zone, and the resort has a 270-foot water slide.
facts.excerpt: Families can enjoy a newly designed family area including an interactive splash zone and our iconic 270-foot water slide.

facts.text: Dew-drop-shaped cabanas made from bamboo and dark wood, designed exclusively for the resort, are scattered across the pool deck.
facts.excerpt: Scattered across the deck and pool area are dewdrop-shaped cabanas that were exclusively designed for the resort. Made from bamboo and dark wood

facts.text: Guests staying in the Hokupa'a tower get access to The Lanai, with panoramic views, Hawaiian breakfast and dinner bites, a private bar, infinity-edge cocktail pools and cultural experiences.
facts.excerpt: Hokupa‘a guests will be treated to panoramic views, daily artisanal Hawaiian breakfast and dinner bites, a private bar, infinity-edge cocktail pools, and cultural experiences.

facts.text: Cultural experiences at The Lanai include lei po'o making, talk story sessions, ukulele lessons, chef demonstrations and live music.
facts.excerpt: the making of fresh lei po‘o, Mo‘olelo "talk story" sessions, ukulele lessons, chef demonstrations, live musical events and more.

facts.text: The resort has a Heavenly Spa by Westin offering massages, facials, body treatments and couples massages.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy therapeutic massages, cleansing facials, and invigorating body treatments at our Maui spa.

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa has open-air lounge spaces with oceanfront views.
facts.excerpt: open-air lounge spaces that offer sunshine and oceanfront views

facts.text: The Wailele Luau features a fire knife performance, hula and a traditional island-style dinner.
facts.excerpt: Experience Maui's most spectacular fire knife performance. Immerse yourself in the rich culture of the Hawaiian Islands through ‘oli and hula over a traditional island-style dinner

facts.text: Guests can join an outrigger canoe experience, available daily for ages 6 and up.
facts.excerpt: Connect with the ocean as Hawaiians have for centuries through our outrigger canoe adventure experience. Available daily for ages 6 and up.

facts.text: Ulu Kitchen by Merriman is a beachfront restaurant using fresh island ingredients and food made from scratch.
facts.excerpt: Ulu Kitchen by Merriman features the freshest island ingredients and carefully crafted food made from scratch. Enjoy the versatile selections in this beachfront dining in West Maui.

facts.text: The Westin Family Kids Club offers arts and crafts, nature adventures, lei-making and animal expeditions.
facts.excerpt: including arts and crafts, nature adventures, lei-making, and animal expeditions

facts.text: Whalers Village, with restaurants, shops and entertainment, is a block away.
facts.excerpt: Walk a block to Whalers Village and discover upscale restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues.

facts.text: Kahului Airport, the main airport, is about 45 minutes from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Approximately 45 minutes from our hotel, Kahului Airport (OGG) is our main airport

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Hokupa'a tower guests get larger indoor and outdoor room layouts.
facts.excerpt: Hōkūpa‘a Tower guests will not only find larger indoor and outdoor room layouts
